articles.summary: From 42 service centers to more than 2,500 locations across North America, Valvoline Inc. marks a milestone year Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV), the quick, easy, trusted leader in preventive automotive maintenance, recognizes a milestone year marking 10 years as a public company and 40 years in the retail automotive services business. “Forty years ago, Valvoline Inc. entered retail with a simple idea to make routine vehicle care faster, easier, and more trusted for busy drivers,” said Lori Flees, President and Chief Executive Officer of Valvoline Inc. “That promise remains and these milestones are about more than longevity, they’re about the team members, franchisees, and customers who have helped shape our journey. From our first retail service centers to our network today, our purpose remains: we simplify vehicle care so customers can do what drives them.” Valvoline Inc.’s retail growth story began in 1986 with the acquisition of 42 Rapid Oil Change locations in Minneapolis,
articles.title: Valvoline Inc. Marks 10 Years as a Public Company and 40 Years in Retail Service
